content: Runata juchayachishcamanda
Maican fariseoguna Jerusalenmanda shamushcauna Moises mandashcata yachachiccunandi Jesuspagma shamusha tapunaura,
Imamandata camba runaguna ñucanchi ñaupa yachachishcagunata mana pactachinaun. Camba runaguna micungaraushcai paiguna maquita mana maillarinaun ñucanchi huañuc apayayaguna tunu yachachishcacuintaga.
Tapunaupi Jesus randi tapura, Cangunaga imaraicuta Dios mandashcata pactachinarandiga canguna apayayaguna tunu causanallata catinguichi.
Diosca casnami mandara: Camba yayatas camba mamatas cadsuna manguichi nishca. Maican runas paihua yayata, mamata camisha jiridsata rimashaga paillatami huañuchun, Dios nishami mandashca.

Randi canguna ninguichi, shuc runa paihua yayagunata rimasha tucui ñuca charishcata Diosma cumbirashcani, cangunata cunan yanapangahua mana imas tiyahuanzhu nisha rimashaga paigunata mana yanapanachan nisha rimanguichi. Chasna nisha canguna munashca causana tunuta catingahuaca Dios mandashcataga mana balichinguichichu.
Llullaisiquiguna manguichi. Alitami Dios rimashcata pasachic Isaias cangunamanda quillcara casna rimasha:

content.text: Cai runaguna paiguna shimillahuanmi ñucata llaquihuanaun
randi paiguna shunguga ñucamanda caruibi maun.
Paiguna yachachishca shimiga runa yuyaimandalla mandashcaguna manaun.

content: Chihuasha Jesus tucui chi runagunata mayanllayaichi nisha rimara, Ñáucata intindisha uyahuaichi.
Shimibi yaicuc micunaga runata mana juchayachinzhu, randi runa shimimanda rimashcaga runata juchayachinmi.
Jesus casna rimacpi pai japishca runaguna paita ninaura, Fariseogunaga can rimashcata uyasha yapa piñarinaura.
Rimanaupi pai nira, Shuc ruyata mana tarpushcata pilashcacuinta ñuca jahuapachai tiyac Yaya paiguna yachachishcata rangami.

Saquichilla paigunataga imasnas anauchun. Shuc puyuñahui runaga shuc puyuñahui runata pushaupi ishcandi (2) juctu ucui urmangauna. Chi fariseo runaguna chasnacuintallata manaun. Puyuñahui runagunacuinta ashallata puyuñahuicuinta ac runagunataga pushanaun.
Casna Jesus rimacpi Pedro nira, Imatata chasna nishaga yachachingui.
Tapucpi cutipasha nira, Cangunahuas chara manachu intindinguichi.
Aichamanda manachu yachanguichi. Shimi ucuibi yaicucca huicsama pasan, chihuasha pagllama llucshin.
Randi shimimanda llucshic rimanaga shungumandami llucshin, chimi runataga jiridsayachin.
Runa shungumandami llucshinaun mana ali yuyaigunaga, runata huanchina, shucpa huarmita quichusha japina, ashiyana, shuhuana, llullana, caminagunahuas.
Chigunami runataga jiridsayachin, randi micungahua maquita mana maillashcaga runata mana juchayachinzhu, nira.
Canaan llactamanda sinzhi quiric huarmi
Jesus chasna runagunata yachachishcahuasha chimanda llucshisha Sidón, Tiro llactaguna partima rira.

Canaan llactamanda shuc mana-israel huarmi Jesuspagma caparisha shamura, israelgunata mandac rey amu Davidmanda mirai angui señor, chasna asha ñucata yuyarisha yanapahuai. Ñáuca ushushita paihua aichai auc supai yapa turmintachipan.

Chasna caparigllaita Jesus mana imatas paita rimarachu. Pai chunga ishcai (12) japishca runagunaga paita ruganaura, Cai huarmi caparisha ñucanchita catimun, pai tapushcata cui uctalla pai chunllayachun.
Jesus cutipasha nira, Ñáucaga chingarishca ovejagunacuinta israelmanda miraigunamalla cachashca mani.
Randi chi huarmi Jesuspagma shamusha paihua ñaupacpi cungurisha nira, Yanapahuai señor.
Chasna nicpi Jesus paita nira, Israel runaguna Diospa huahuagunashina anaun. Huahuaguna micucta quichusha allcu huahuagunashina shuc runagunama cucpiga mana balinzhu.
Rimacpi chi huarmi randi nira, Sirtu chasna man señor, chasna acpihuas allcugunaga mesamanda jicharic acuhuataga micuc manaun. Chicuinta ashillata yanapahuai señor.
Chita uyasha Jesus nira, Yapa alitami Diosta quiringui, chasnamandami can munashcacuinta tucuchun. Chi ratullai chi huarmihua ushushimanda supai llucshicpi ali tucura.
Ashca ungushca runagunata Jesus janbishcamanda
Jesus chimanda risha Galilea cucha mayanda pasaura. Chibi shuc urcuma sicasha tiyarira.

Ashca runaguna pai tiyaushcama shamunaura ima tunu unguyuccunatas apamusha, mana puric runaguna, puyuñahuiguna, mana rimaccuna, huaglishca maquiyuccuna, shuccunahuas. Paigunata Jesuspa ñaupacpi churacpi pai tucuigunata janbira.

Janbicpi chi mana rimaccunaga rimangahua callarinaura, huaglishca maquiguna alichishca tucunaura, mana puric runaguna alita puric tucunaura, puyuñahuiguna ña ricuc tucunaura. Tucui chi runaguna Jesus rashcagunata ricusha manzharisha israelgunahua Diosta alabangahua callarinaura.
Jesus chuscu huaranga (4.000) runagunata carashcamanda

Chihuasha Jesus pai japishca runagunata caima shamuichi nisha, cai runagunata ricusha llaquirini nira. Ricuichi ña quimsa (3) punzhata ñucahuan anaushca, cunan micunata mana charinaunzhu. Ñáucanchi paigunata mana carasha cachaupiga mana alitachu yachihuan, paiguna raicaihuan ñambita riusha sambayasha purinata mana ushanaungachu.
Nicpi pai japishca runaguna ninaura, Cai mayanllaiga huasiguna illanmi, chasna acpi maimandata paigunata carashunya cai tucui ashcataga.
Chasna ninaupi Jesus paigunata tapura, Masna pandata charinguichi. Tapucpi cutipanaura, Canzhis (7) panda charinchi, ashicua yacu aichatahuas.
Chita uyasha Jesus nira, Tucui runagunata allpaibi tiyarichi nira.
Tiyarinaupi Jesus chi canzhis pangunata yacu aichagunatahuas japisha Yaya Diosta pagrachu nishcahuasha chi micunata paquisha pai japishca runagunama cura paiguna randi runagunata carangahua.
Tucuiguna sacsacta micunaura. Chihuasha pai japishca runagunaga chi micuna puchushcata tandasha canzhis ashangata jundachinaura.
Micuc carigunalla chuscu huaranga (4.000) tupushi anaura, huarmigunata huahuagunatahuas mana yupanaurachu.
Chihuasha Jesus runagunata dispirisha canuaibi yaicusha paihua runagunandi Magdala nishca partima rinaura.
